A symbol of courage given to those who have overcome the challenges of a shrine.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== Spirit Orbs are symbols of courage obtained from the [[Sheikah]] [[Monk]]s after completing their [[Ancient Shrine]]s. They are spherical, translucent items bearing the [[Goddess Crest]] in their center. [[Link]] can pray to [[Goddess Statue]]s to upgrade either his total [[Heart]]s or [[Stamina Vessel]]s in exchange for four Spirit Orbs.{{Cite|In exchange for {{Color BotW|Red|four}} {{Color BotW|Blue|Spirit Orbs}}, I will amplify your being.|Goddess Statue|BotW}} There are a total of 120 Spirit Orbs to be obtained in the base game, which allows Link to receive 30 upgrades. An additional four Spirit Orbs can be obtained from Ancient Shrines that appear on the [[Great Plateau]] during the "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]" [[Main Quest]] as part of ''[[The Champions' Ballad]]'' DLC Pack, allowing Link to receive one additional upgrade. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Heart Container * Light of Blessing * Medoh's Emblem * Naboris's Emblem * Rudania's Emblem * Ruta's Emblem * Stamina Vessel }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Jewels, Orbs |items= BotW |key-items= BotW }}
